rationale: Phase-3 and all prior experiments executed from a dirty working tree with untracked test/model files. The formal experiment source baseline must bind the complete snapshot, not just HEAD.

tracked_diff_sha256.description: SHA256 of all tracked file modifications (git diff HEAD output)

canonical_12file_manifest_sha256.description: SHA256 manifest of 12 critical untracked files (tests, model artifacts, Phase-2/Phase-3 evidence)

reproducibility_contract.given_these_four_sha256: An independent party can reconstruct the exact source state
reproducibility_contract.reason: Critical untracked files (tests, models, thresholds) are not in Git history
reproducibility_contract.snapshot_preservation: Dirty working tree is the authoritative baseline, not a commit to be cleaned

decision_d10_framing.corrected_wording: D10 = Composite baseline identity (4 SHA256 components)
decision_d10_framing.human_approval_required_for: Approval of the complete composite identity as frozen source baseline
